author: A disgraced Breton courtier
pages:
#The Courts

High Rock is a hundred little kingdoms, each with a court, each court with a hundred intrigues. Poison is a form of conversation. A good marriage is a declaration of war on everyone not invited.

I was very good at all of this, until I was not.

#The Covens

In the moors and the forests live the witches, who answer to no court. The nobles fear them, hire them, and burn them, usually in that order.

If you must deal with a coven, bring a gift, keep your true name to yourself, and never, ever eat the stew.
